text: Now query. Note the classic trap: durability max may be shared by multiple heroes, but filtered by Dark Horse Comics. Let's write SQL.

input.sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 10
